Earth to Moon: How Long Would It Take? 

Ever wondered how long it would take to reach the Moon if you traveled in a straight line—without orbits, gravity assists, or detours? 🌕🚀
From walking and cycling to jets and rockets, this visual compares different speeds and shows just how vast the distance between Earth and the Moon really is.
Space isn’t just far… it’s mind-blowingly far. 🌌
Which one surprised you the most? 👀
